metadata.source: WATTCH_SH.csv and WATTCH_landfalls_SH.csv; Wikipedia storm histories used to cross-check historical identity.
metadata.selection: Seven WATTCH scenarios with identifiable real-world Madagascar landfalls corroborated by storm dates and observational cyclone accounts; excludes ambiguous identifications.
metadata.caution: Forecast trajectories are ensemble hindcasts. No daily initialized updates are included; daily positions within same initialization are forecast valid times, not new forecasts. Landfall bounding box is approximate (-26 to -11 latitude, 43 to 51 longitude). Wind units retained as in WATTCH archive; check metadata before converting.
metadata.identity_status: Names are cross-checked against dates and reference-track locations; exact IBTrACS SID linkage and observed landfall wind estimates remain separate verification tasks.
metadata.name_verification_method: Confirm storm name in Wikipedia SWIO cyclone season article matching WATTCH initialization year/month; confirm activity dates overlap and recorded Madagascar landfall. This validates name/date consistency, not exact IBTrACS SID mapping.
